hero.headline: Your Attendees Are Your Best Ad Agency
hero.subhead: The easiest photo frame generator built for event organizers. Transform attendee selfies into professional, branded posts that grow your organic reach.

howItWorks.title: 1. Upload Your Frame
howItWorks.description: Create and upload your branded PNG frame. Use our Theme Editor to match the tool's look to your event's identity in minutes.

howItWorks.title: 2. Share the Link
howItWorks.description: Embed the generator into your website or share a direct link. Attendees upload their selfies, and our system perfectly fits them into your frame.

howItWorks.title: 3. Watch the Growth
howItWorks.description: Attendees download and share their professional, branded photos. Your event's message spreads across social feeds through authentic recommendations.

demo.headline: Experience it like your attendees will
demo.subhead: Don't just take our word for it. Try our live demo to see how seamless the photo experience is on any device.

useCases.title: Business Conferences & Summits
useCases.description: Turn networking into marketing. Give your attendees a professional way to share their experience. Boost sponsor visibility and dominate LinkedIn and X feeds with high-quality, branded content that builds professional authority.

useCases.title: Music Festivals & Concerts
useCases.description: Drive viral ticket sales. Your fans are your best promoters. Let them announce their arrival with high-energy frames designed to go viral on Instagram Stories and TikTok. Turn every selfie into an authentic organic ad that their friends can’t miss.

useCases.title: Grassroots Movements
useCases.description: Amplify your voice without a marketing budget. Whether it’s a social cause or a local rally, help supporters spread a unified message across Facebook and X. Turn every selfie into a digital placard that makes your movement impossible to ignore in social discussions.

free.title: Free
free.description: Best for: Trying Make-frame or small, occasional activations.

premium.title: Premium
premium.description: Best for: Professional organizers and marketing teams.
features: Unused frames roll over for up to 3 months

pricing.addOnsNote: Packages never expire and work on every plan. Premium subscribers get 35% off automatically.

fairUsage.headline: Never Lose What You Pay For
fairUsage.subhead: Our Fair Usage Policy ensures you get every bit of value from your plan.

points.title: Smart Rollover
points.description: Unused Premium frames don't vanish. They roll over for up to 3 months, and you can accumulate up to 300% of your monthly plan (2,250 frames).

points.title: Fair Usage Logic
points.description: On Premium we use your rolled-over frames first, then the current month, and your purchased packages only after that. On Free, purchased packages are used first, so paid frames never wait behind the free allowance.

points.title: Permanent Add-ons
points.description: Extra Frame Packages never expire and don't require a subscription. Buy them on Free or Premium — the frames stay in your account until you use them.
